aligned_contract.timing_action: 15Hz policy,150Hz physics,10ticks/action,FIFO delay4ticks(26.7ms). Raw Gaussian -> tanh once; throttle=(u3+1)/2; roll/pitch +/-pi/6rad,yaw-rate +/-pi/1.5rad/s,maxcollective .775313294N.
aligned_contract.history: Actor10 chronological28-feature frames+current row-major8x8 depth=344;critic10x37+64=434. Oldest first,zero-filled at reset. Last action is processed normalized command,not radians/Newtons.
aligned_contract.scale: Velocity x25;body-to-world rotation row-major x127;gyro x30;[world XY goal direction,absolute goal z] x127;z error x30;speed x25;last action x127;ToF[left,right,back,down] and forward depth x30.
aligned_contract.noise: Independent elementwise multiplicative N(1,sigma^2):velocity .3;gyro/z error/auxiliary ToF/forward depth .1;goal XY displacement .2 before normalization. Rotation,speed,last action clean. Fresh each observation;history retains original noise. Critic clean except shared noisy goal direction.
aligned_contract.dropout: One p~U(0,.15) shared per batch/observation;independent pixel/world Bernoulli(p);invalid forward pixels ->4m BEFORE multiplicative noise. Auxiliary ToF has no dropout. Shared p correlates dropout frequency;noisy depth can exceed4m.
aligned_contract.camera: 8x8 pinhole,pixel centers arange+.5,focal20,aperture20.955,image-plane depth capped4m,mount offsets.02m. Native analytic intersections replace Isaac triangles;numeric samples need not coincide.
aligned_contract.controller_randomization: Once per world at construction:mass=.049*U(.8,1.2);controller inertia=[21.6e-6,21.6e-6,43.3e-6]*(mass/.049);wind force uses same mass. Neither randomizes physical-body mass/inertia.
aligned_contract.wind: Each150Hz tick alpha=exp(-dt/1s), w_next=alpha*w+.5*sqrt(1-alpha^2)*N(0,I), independent axes/worlds; reset w=0. World force=controller_mass*w. Critic uses mean over10ticks.
aligned_contract.thrust: Per reset eta0~U(.85,1), degradation factor~U(.10,.15)/1200. Every PHYSICS tick eta=max(eta*(1-rate),.7). Collective thrust is scaled; controller torque is not.
aligned_contract.spawn_goal_speed: Free grid xy[-7,7),z[.5,1.5),step.2,clearance.20m;no spawn jitter;yaw U(-pi,pi). Independent goal+axiswise U(-.15,.15)m;speed U(.5,1.5)m/s times clip(goal distance,0,1). Height randomizer off.
aligned_contract.map_curriculum: Two maps;do not overwrite occupied map;regenerate after3000 nonempty reset batches. Last100 success>.9=>spacing/1.1,floor.4m;hold+.1s toward2s. At floor,overspeed=.6,speed-match=.2. Native rollout-boundary maintenance adds up to120 reset-batch lag.
aligned_contract.map_distribution: 16x16m;Poisson columns w/l U(.4,.8),height U(2.4,2.5);uniform-SO3 floating boxes/cylinders/cones,size U(.4,.8),center z U(.3,1.7).
aligned_contract.hover_curriculum: Both target initial_hold+(max-initial_hold)*success_rate,capped at max;hold increments at most.1s. Native self.config stays initial;self.cfg stores updates.

material_plant_and_collision_differences.physics: Plants differ despite aligned interfaces/laws. Native official CF21B:mass.0434kg,Jdiag[25e-6,28e-6,49e-6],RPM curves,motor lag,prop inertia,drag,mixer,RK4. Isaac uses direct controller wrench,USD/PhysX mass attribute.049kg,inertia attributes[1.3615e-5,1.3615e-5,3.257e-5],root scale1.5. Effective inertia requires runtime measurement.
material_plant_and_collision_differences.wind_effect: Same wind force yields native acceleration .049/.0434=1.129032 times reference nominal acceleration;retain official native defaults.
material_plant_and_collision_differences.thrust_effect: Isaac eta scales immediate commanded force;native corrects current RPM-derived thrust while retaining motor/RK4 transients.
